rationale: Direct check for the accepted obligation claim-snapshot-install-stale-watermark, using the already accepted binding bind-install-snapshot-watermark (Raft.installSnapshot, raft.go 1814-1955). The harness gives a follower a log watermark above the snapshot it installs and uses the monotonic-store branch so removeOldLogs really clears the log, then reads the follower's own watermark against the installed snapshot index. I compiled and ran the harness locally in a scratch copy first; it builds, installSnapshot succeeds, and the follower reports log index 10 while the store holds nothing and the installed snapshot index is 4.
